applicationStart: cd code_deploy_application && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && { nohup python3 -m gunicorn -b 0.0.0.0:8080 app:app >> /root/application.log 2>&1 & APP_PID=$!; echo "$APP_PID" > /root/application.pid; sleep 2; kill -0 "$APP_PID"; }
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /root/application.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
